verdict.rationale: Titan Security Key is a physical FIDO/U2F hardware authenticator, not a web service, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this kind of product. The runtime probe confirms Titan ships no vendor API, SDK, CLI or MCP surface of its own, and fleet management goes through the separate Google Workspace Admin console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
